card.title: SPITFIRE Mk Ia
card.flavorText: The famous Supermarine Spitfire was a British fighter aircraft used by the RAF and the Allies, during and after WWII. The aircraft was very agile, but traded its range with speed and maneuverability. This meant that it did not do well as an offensive aircraft, but it served its purpose exceptionally well as a defensive aircraft, especially during the Battle of Britain. Many variants of the Spitfire were built and it was produced in greater numbers than any other British aircraft.
